visual_action: A montage of clips celebrating the confirmation of Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court. The video shows her speaking at a hearing, walking with President Joe Biden, and smiling. It also shows Biden watching the confirmation vote on TV and hugging Jackson. Vice President Kamala Harris is shown presiding over the vote. The montage culminates in shots of Jackson, Biden, and Harris walking out of the White House together and Jackson being sworn in. Many of the clips transition from color to black and white for stylistic effect.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: She is the subject of the entire montage, her name is featured in the on-screen text, and she appears in nearly every shot.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is shown walking with, watching, and hugging Ketanji Brown Jackson.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is shown in a split screen presiding over the Senate confirmation vote and later walking with Jackson and Biden.

cast.name: Supreme Court
cast.evidence: Mentioned in the on-screen text: "...confirmed to the Supreme Court".

on_screen_text.text: One year ago, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson was confirmed to the Supreme Court 👩🏾‍⚖️

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it is set entirely to music.
audio_music: The video is set to a slow, emotive, and celebratory instrumental track with a prominent, echoing vocal melody. The music creates a sense of historic significance and pride. Per the fingerprint, the track changes around 7 seconds in from 'fear' by Virgi dj to 'I adore this' by LonelyEve.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced montage using crossfades, split-screen effects, and a stylistic transition from color to black-and-white for many of the clips.
central_claim: The one-year anniversary of Ketanji Brown Jackson's historic confirmation to the Supreme Court is a significant achievement worth celebrating.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of pride and inspiration regarding this historic event and to credit the Democratic party and Biden-Harris administration for it.
